# Philadelphia FIGHT

> > Philadelphia FIGHT Community Health Centers provides comprehensive HIV care, patient education, and community health services throughout Philadelphia.

Philadelphia FIGHT operates the John Bell Health Center and partners with organizations like the CDC, American Foundation for AIDS Research (AMFAR), and Community Programs on Clinical Research of AIDS. The organization serves diverse populations with clinical care, research participation through the Community Based Clinical Trials Network, and social support services including rental assistance and mental health resources.

## Key Topics

- HIV care and testing
- Patient education resources
- John Bell Health Center
- COVID-19 response and relief
- Rental assistance programs
- Mental health awareness

- Pediatrics and family care
- Social justice advocacy

- Urban health mission

## Patient Education & Health Resources

- [Asthma](https://fight.org/programs-and-services/patient-education/asthma): Patient education guide on asthma triggers, prevention, and management
- [Postpartum Depression](https://fight.org/programs-and-services/patient-education/postpartum-depression): Patient education on postpartum depression symptoms and support
- [Nothing Tastes As Good As Healthy Feels!](https://fight.org/nothing-tastes-as-good-as-healthy-feels): HIV nutrition and healthy eating guide for wellness and care
- [Get to know your words: Influenza](https://fight.org/get-to-know-your-words-influenza): Word Wednesday health education series on influenza and flu vaccine
